response.overview: Do You Still Remember? is a personal documentary about the relationship between a father and daughter, whose common language for a long time was basketball. Through childhood memories, family archive footage, and present-day images, I revisit the moments that once brought us together. The film grew out of the sense of loss I felt as I drifted apart from my father. It is a personal attempt to reconnect, exploring feelings that for a long time were easier to process through filmmaking than to express in person.
response.title: Do You Still Remember?
